item.description:
DISPOSABLE INCONTINENCE BED PAD 

• Breathable top layer - gentle on skin
• Ultra absorbent core layer - holds up to 500g of liquid 
• Quick absorption
• Leak preventive under layer (PE material)
• Clean, neat, easy to dispose
• Convenient disposable pads
• Affordable for everyday use

Options
• 45x60cm - 50pc/packet
• 60x60cm - 40pc/packet
• 90x60cm - 20pc/packet

++++++++++++

ANTIBACTERIAL ADULT CARE
CLEANING WET WIPES

• Extra-Large Size: 20cm x 18cm, ample coverage for efficient cleaning.​
• Extra-Moisture: 4.2x moisture, effective cleaning
• Alcohol & Paraben-Free: Ensures a gentle, non-irritating experience suitable for sensitive skin.​
• Ribbed Texture: Allows for quicker and thorough clean-up
• Clip-on packaging for maximum moisture retention

SPECIFICATION
• Material: Non-woven fabric
• Size of each sheet: 200mm x 180mm
• Sheets: 80pc/ pkt
• Expiry: 3 years from production
• Weight: 655g/ pkt
• Unscented

++++++++++++

DIAPERING AND CLEANING 
BABY WIPES

• Large Size: 20cm x 15cm, ample coverage for efficient cleaning
• Made with PO pure water: gentle and non-irritating. Soft and skin friendly
• Maintained at pH5.5 - similar to baby's natural skin carrier to avoid irritation
• Alcohol & Paraben-Free
• Clip-on packaging for maximum moisture retention
• Quality assurance: Product standard: GB/T27728 and Hygiene standard: GB15979

SPECIFICATION
• Material: Spunlace non-woven fabric, RO pure water
• Size of each sheet: 200mm x 150mm
• Sheets: 80pc/ pkt
• Expiry: 2 years from production (May 2027)
• Weight: 700g/ pkt
• Unscented

ADVISE FOR USE
• For external use only
• Avoid direct contact with eyes or wound
